title: P34-D001 Temporary Risk Treatment
rationale: Leaked-password protection is not available on the current Free plan. Current live identity evidence shows no Supabase password-auth users, so the present exposure is materially reduced while the fleet remains Google-only.
activationRequires: identity provider aggregate still contains no password-auth users
no email/password sign-in path is intentionally enabled without renewed review
reopenImmediatelyIf: an email/password identity or password sign-in path is introduced
Supabase makes leaked-password protection available on the current plan and it remains disabled without review
